title: E0108: Dynamic Instantiation
plain_english: Instantiating a class using a name that comes from user input can allow an attacker to instantiate any autoloadable class, potentially leading to object injection.
why_matters: Combined with gadget chains, dynamic class instantiation can: - Instantiate any autoloadable class - Trigger object injection via magic methods - Lead to remote code execution
what_it_checks: `new $class()` where `$class` comes from superglobal array access
`class_exists()` followed by instantiation of user-controlled class names
